# Code editor

CodeMirror 5.65.21, self-hosted under the MIT license in `codemirror-LICENSE.txt`.
Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/codemirror/v/5.65.21
Documentation: https://codemirror.net/5/doc/manual.html

The JavaScript bundle concatenates the upstream core, clike, Lua, JavaScript,
properties, YAML and XML modes, searchcursor, matchbrackets, closebrackets,
comment and active-line addons. Upstream copyright notices are preserved.
The panel supplies its own theme, Pawn MIME definition and localized controls.
No CDN or external scripts are used by the page.
